balancesPage.title: Balances
balancesPage.allSettledDescription: No outstanding balances in this group.
balancesPage.suggestedNote: The fewest transfers that clear these balances. Recording one adds a payment; nothing already recorded changes.

landing.title: Shared expenses. Fairly balanced.
landing.lead: Balancia tracks what a group spends and works out who owes whom — on a server you control, with no third party in the middle of your money.
landing.registrationClosed: Registration is closed on this instance. Ask the administrator for an account, or use a guest invitation link if you have one.

splits.title: Splits that always add up
splits.body: Equal, exact, percentage or share-based. Amounts are whole minor units, so allocations sum to the total exactly — every time.

payers.title: Several payers, no workarounds
payers.body: When two people cover one bill, record it once. Balances follow who actually paid what.

currency.title: Multi-currency, two ways
currency.body: Keep each currency balanced separately, or convert everything into one base currency at a rate frozen when you record it.

passkeys.title: Passkeys and guest links
passkeys.body: Sign in with a passkey or a password. Invite people who do not want an account through a revocable link.

receipts.title: Receipts kept private
receipts.body: Attach photos or PDFs. They live in your own storage, behind authorization — never in a public folder.

recurring.title: Recurring expenses
recurring.body: Rent, subscriptions, the shared internet bill. Generated on schedule in your group's own timezone.

landing.selfHostBody: Balancia is free software under the AGPL-3.0-or-later licence. It runs from one Docker Compose file with PostgreSQL and a background worker, sends nothing to third-party services, and includes no analytics or telemetry.
landing.footerLicence: AGPL-3.0-or-later. Modified network versions must offer source.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Balancia needs a connection to your server to show balances and record expenses. Nothing is lost — reconnect and everything will be where you left it.

securityPage.title: Passkeys & security
securityPage.intro: A passkey lets you sign in with your device's own unlock — fingerprint, face or PIN — instead of typing a password.
securityPage.insecure: Passkeys need HTTPS. This instance is served over plain HTTP from a non-localhost address, so your browser will refuse to create one. Put Balancia behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy and set to the https:// address.

receiptScanner.title: Scan a receipt
receiptScanner.onDevice: Recognition happens on this device. The photo is not sent anywhere to be read.
receiptScanner.tips: Lay the receipt flat, keep it all in frame, and shoot straight on. You can also drop an image here.
receiptScanner.keepImage: Also keep the photo with this expense

errors.timeout: Reading the receipt took too long and was stopped. A smaller photo usually helps.
errors.attachFailed: The expense is ready, but the photo could not be uploaded.

review.uncertain: This one was hard to read — worth checking.

issues.itemsMissingSubtotal: The items add up to {items}, but the receipt says the subtotal is {subtotal}. Difference: {difference}.

issues.itemsExceedTotal: The items add up to {items}, which is more than the total of {total}. A discount may have been missed.
issues.negativeTotal: The total was read as a negative amount ({total}). Check it before continuing.
